functions.name: get_course_recommendations
functions.title: Get course recommendations
functions.description: Returns 3-5 personalized learning-path and room recommendations for a student, based on their enrollments and module progress. Call this when a student asks what to learn next on HackQuest. Read-only; does not modify any data.

enrollments.description: The student's course enrollments. Each item has course_title (string) and enrollment_date (string).

courseProgress.description: The student's module progress. Each item has module_title (string), status (one of not_started, in_progress, completed), and completion_date (string, may be null).

functions.name: generate_certificate
functions.title: Generate quiz certificate
functions.description: Generates a PDF certificate of achievement for a completed quiz, awarded to the signed-in user. Call this after a user passes a quiz and wants their certificate. Returns a PDF file; read-only with respect to app data.

quiz_title.description: The title of the completed quiz.

attempt_date.description: ISO date string for the attempt; defaults to today if omitted.

functions.name: check_missing_material
functions.title: Check missing learning material
functions.description: Admin-only audit that lists rooms whose tasks are missing learning material. Call this to find rooms that still need educational content. Read-only; requires an admin account.
